text: Fixing #6573 (CSV numeric rounding): real VFP9 probe (retained ~/temp/vfp9-probes/csv-numeric-round-6573) shows APPEND FROM TYPE CSV rounds decimal text half away from zero BY DIGITS to the field scale (-1.235 -> -1.24, 1.005 -> 1.01, 2.675 -> 2.68) and Copperfin stored unrounded text when it fit (1.005 kept three decimals in N(5,2)) or rejected when the raw text was wider. Rounding is applied in the local-DBF text-import loop only (a first attempt inside the shared DBF writer broke Studio FRX section tests and a metadata-cursor test, so it was scoped). Values still too wide after rounding keep the existing reject+rollback; VFP's silent zero / decimal-dropping there is the open #6572 owner decision (recommend keeping the rejection). Fail-first: 25 failures before, 0 after in test_prg_engine_csv_numeric_scale.
